The '''630 freighter''' was produced by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
A Ghtroc 630 freighter was used by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota's]] [[Kota's Militia|squad]] to get to the [[Battle of the Nordra Nebula]].
